mapper.select: SELECT cards_json FROM trend_guide_cache WHERE cache_key = #{cacheKey} AND expires_at > now()
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trend_guide_cache (cache_key, tier, cards_json, expires_at) VALUES (#{cacheKey}, #{tier}, #{cardsJson}, now() + interval '1 day') ON CONFLICT (cache_key) DO UPDATE SET tier = #{tier}, cards_json = #{cardsJson}, created_at = now(), expires_at = now() + interval '1 day'
